title: Adobe releases security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-376.11.16.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – Adobe Releases Security Updates
leadParagraph: Adobe has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products.
contentHtml:
Adobe has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products.

An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

It is encouraged that users and administrators, review the Adobe security advisories and apply the necessary updates.

For advisory information and updates, please visit the links below:
Adobe Connect
Adobe Reader for Android
